item.title: WWAY and Novant Health host annual community health fair at Independence Mall
item.description: On Thursday, WWAY and Novant Health came together to host the annual Health Fair.

item.title: Winter wonderland possible in Cape Fear region as experts urge caution
item.description: The Cape Fear Region could potentially see a winter wonderland this weekend.

item.title: Drivers urged to stay home this weekend as NCDOT prepares for snow in the Cape Fear
item.description: The winter storm is forecast to impact much of the state including the cape fear this weekend. The North Carolina Department of Transportation began mobilizing its salt trucks on Wednesday ahead of the forecasted snow.

item.title: The Cape Fear Veteran Resilience Project Hosts Town Hall to Address Veterans’ Needs
item.description: The Cape Fear Veteran Resilience Project hosted a town hall meeting tonight, Jan.29. The meeting was centered around addressing the needs and problems which the local veteran community has.

item.title: Through art, Wilmington artist asks viewers to see homelessness differently
item.description: A new exhibit at the Arts Council of Wilmington and New Hanover County uses black-and-white portraits to highlight the humanity and dignity of people experiencing homelessness in the Port City.

item.title: Melania Trump’s documentary premieres at the Kennedy Center ahead of global release
item.description: Melania Trump is capping her first year back as first lady with the global release of a documentary she produced about the 20 days leading up to husband Donald Trump’s return to the White House.

item.title: Trump threatens tariffs on any country selling oil to Cuba, a move that puts pressure on Mexico
item.description: President Donald Trump on Thursday signed an executive order that would impose a tariff on any goods from countries that sell or provide oil to Cuba, a move that could further cripple an island plagued by a deepening energy crisis.

item.title: Parents provide feedback during New Hanover County Schools budget town hall
item.description: The board held a budget town hall to allow staff an opportunity to share how the district is doing and to get feedback from parents.

item.title: Pender County Commissioner comments on playground equipment investigation
item.description: Law enforcement is looking into how the park equipment, which belongs to the county, was transferred to a nearby neighborhood.

item.title: Wrightsville Beach Chamber of Commerce raises concerns over impact from future projects
item.description: On Monday, some business owners from Wrightsville Beach and near the intersection of Eastwood and Military Cutoff Road gathered for an information session about a project called the flyover.
